answer: The shepherd cuts his tally in the evening, when the flock is counted back through the gate one ewe at a time. Proof of shepherd flock via tally stick notch is the cutting: a flock the shepherd counts only after 120 ewes are notched, each notch cut on the tally stick. The plume is the first notch, cut when the lambs were born; the forge is the last, cut when the flock came home. A cheat must cut 25 false notches and drive 25 false flocks through the gate, and the nadir still shows no sheep of his own.
